title: Preserve authored opening sound-event preroll
scope: Preserve the valid opening Sound automation at position -0.125 in the GPIF grace fixture without clamping its position.
acceptance: testdata/gp7/grace.gp must pass the sound-position export boundary and retain bar 0, position -0.125, and the exact referenced sound through Go and pinned AlphaTab.
Retain event order relative to a position-zero event and other equal-position events. No event may be silently moved to zero.

For this evidenced slice, support finite opening-bar positions in [-0.125, 0), while regular positions remain in [0, 1]. Explicitly reject earlier preroll and negative positions on later bars; test -0.125, zero and values just outside the supported bounds. Document this as a bounded support contract, not a universal GPIF limit.

Continue rejecting non-finite positions, invalid bar/sound references and unsupported positions with precise diagnostics. Align preflight, validation and serialization without changing positive-position semantics.
exclusions: Do not infer a universal negative-position range from a permissive AlphaTab parser or add a playback engine.

reproduction.instructions: testdata/gp7/grace.gp must pass the sound-position export boundary and retain bar 0, position -0.125, and the exact referenced sound through Go and pinned AlphaTab. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
implementation-ready: The source contains bar 0 Position=-0.125; both parsers accept it and the current GP8 range check rejects it. The implementation must state a bounded preroll contract.
